During a Covid Infection in April 2022, {{player|anni|flag=de}} created '''Analog''' in 3 days with [[2on2]] in mind. It is an action packed map with multiple powerups. To unlock Pent you have find 5 buttons, that are more or less hidden in the map. After triggering every button once, the gate will open and you have access to the pent. That will open some new teamplay strategies. This map can be played in [[Single player]] as well.

In the Gallerie you find an overview with spawns and items.

Forum: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/forum/topic/7621 here]. Analog plays fine in [[1on1]], [[2on2]] [[FFA]] and [[Single player]].
